classes.check: Require green fork CI on the exact proposed head before publishing or updating the upstream pull request.
Catalogue reviewer requests only: outside authors cannot request reviewers and the base has no CODEOWNERS.
Require upstream subsystem subjects, a non-empty body, and 72-column message wrapping.
Require a test change for source changes or an explicit C04 self-review reason.
Reject model or tool attribution and fork artifacts in commit messages, drafts, and added diff lines.
Require the pushed head to merge cleanly onto the supplied local upstream ref.
Require one contribution commit unless C07 explains the reviewable split.
Require recorded performance measurements of candidate forms under two compilers.
classes.question: Have candidate kernel, SIMD, or GPU forms been measured under two compilers, with commands and results recorded?

classes.check: Require every resolvable commit ID in drafts to be reachable from the pushed head or upstream ref.
Check for open upstream pull requests touching the same functions before publishing.
Require a release-build reproducer demonstrating an output, exit-code, or memory effect.
classes.question: Does a named release-build input demonstrate the changed output, exit code, or memory use, with before and after evidence?

classes.check: Require checks of fallible calls and resource release on failure in touched functions.
classes.question: Are all fallible calls in touched functions checked and all resources released on failure, with inspected paths recorded?

classes.check: Require a search of sibling backends and call sites, with fixes or an explicit scope reason.
classes.question: Were sibling backends and call sites searched and fixed or explicitly scoped, with search evidence recorded?

classes.check: Require signature status G for every contribution commit in the exact pushed range.
Require prior upstream issue agreement for score, public API, or exit-behaviour changes.
classes.question: Was any score, public API, or exit-behaviour change agreed on the upstream issue first, with the agreement recorded?

classes.check: Require sanitizer evidence for extremal inputs at 8, 10, 12, and 16 bits.
classes.question: Were extremal 8-, 10-, 12-, and 16-bit inputs checked under sanitizers, with commands and results recorded?

classes.check: Reject fork-only paths and contribution ranges exceeding three commits.
